name: 12 Jyotirlingas
prompt: Cinematic montage aerial across India's 12 Jyotirlingas — Somnath's sea-facing sanctum at sunrise, Mahakaleshwar's pre-dawn 4am Bhasma aarti smoke at Ujjain, Kedarnath's stone shikhara framed by snow peaks, Rameshwaram's 197m oil-lamp-lit corridor, Varanasi's Vishwanath gold dome with the Ganga below, the cross-nine-states sacred line, 8 seconds

name: Caves of India
prompt: Cinematic slow tracking through India's great rock-cut caves — Ajanta Cave 1's painted-mural torchlight reveal, Ellora's Kailasa monolithic shikhara from above, Elephanta's 5.4m Trimurti Sadashiva relief, Bhimbetka's 30,000-year-old ochre handprints on a sandstone wall, Belum's underground stream chamber lit by amber LED, 32,000 years of Indian carved-stone history, 8 seconds

name: Iconic Train Journeys of India
prompt: Cinematic montage of India's heritage rail — the Darjeeling Himalayan Railway loop at Batasia at dawn, the Kalka-Shimla's vista-domed Shivalik Express in autumn light, the Nilgiri Mountain Railway X-class steam locomotive on a tea-estate hairpin, the Matheran toy train climbing through monsoon mist, the Konkan Railway threading viaducts between waterfalls, 8 seconds

name: Ramayana Trail
prompt: Cinematic aerial across India's Ramayana sites — Ayodhya's new Ram Mandir spire above the Sarayu River, Chitrakoot's Mandakini ghats where the exile years passed, Nashik's Sita Gufa Panchavati cave, Hampi's Anjaneya Hill (Hanuman's birthplace by tradition) at dawn, Rameshwaram's Pamban Bridge with the Palk Strait beyond — the bridge to Lanka, 8 seconds

name: Christian Heritage Trail
prompt: Cinematic montage of India's Christian heritage anchors — Kochi's St. Francis Church (1503, India's oldest European church), Old Goa's Basilica of Bom Jesus with St. Francis Xavier's silver casket, Panaji's Our Lady of the Immaculate Conception double-staircase, Puducherry's Sacred Heart Basilica neo-Gothic, Tranquebar's Zion Church (1701) inside Fort Dansborg, the 2,000-year denominational layers, 8 seconds

name: Tiruvannamalai
prompt: Cinematic dawn aerial circling Arunachala Hill at Tiruvannamalai — the 1,055m sacred granite mound that IS the lingam of the Pancha Bhoota fire-element temple, the nine-gopuram Annamalaiyar Temple complex (10 hectares) at the foot, full-moon Girivalam pilgrims circumambulating the 14km base path, the Karthigai Deepam beacon site at the summit, soft Tamil-Nadu pre-summer light, 8 seconds

name: Karla & Bhaja Caves
prompt: Cinematic slow tracking through Karla's Great Chaitya hall — 45m-long 1st-century BCE Buddhist nave, 37 octagonal rock-cut pillars converging on the stone stupa, soft amber light filtering through the lunette window, then a quick cut to Bhaja's 22 caves 3km away with their distinctive stupa cluster, Sahyadri-edge afternoon, 8 seconds

name: Kanheri Caves
prompt: Cinematic aerial over the Kanheri basalt outcrop inside Mumbai's Sanjay Gandhi National Park — 109 Buddhist rock-cut caves staircased into the cliff face, the 26m Cave 3 chaitya with twin Buddhas at the entrance, dense forest reclaiming the older rock-cut steps, the Mumbai metro skyline visible 7km east, late-afternoon golden urban-jungle contrast, 8 seconds

name: Borra Caves
prompt: Cinematic slow descent into Borra Caves' main chamber — 150m-deep limestone karst illuminated by amber LED, stalactites and stalagmites converging in a Shiva-lingam-shaped natural formation, the underground stream catching the light, the Vizag-Araku heritage train passing over the Eastern Ghats viaduct above, 8 seconds

name: Katra
prompt: Cinematic dawn aerial over Katra base town climbing toward Trikuta Hills — pony trail and helicopter pad active in the foreground, the 13km uphill path to Vaishno Devi cave shrine winding through Bhairon Ghati at the top, pilgrims in batches of thousands at the Banganga checkpost, the Shivalik range silhouette beyond, soft thin-air morning light, 8 seconds

name: Astavinayak Circuit
prompt: Cinematic montage aerial of Maharashtra's Astavinayak Yatra — the eight swayambhu Ganesha temples in canonical order: Mayureshwar at Morgaon's tortoise-shaped sanctum, the river-island Siddhivinayak at Siddhatek, Ballaleshwar at Pali, Varadvinayak at Mahad, Chintamani at Theur, the rock-cut Girijatmaj at Lenyadri (inside Buddhist caves), Vighnahar at Ozar, Mahaganapati at Ranjangaon — 600km Pune loop, October light, 8 seconds

name: Morgaon
prompt: Cinematic dawn aerial circling the Mayureshwar temple at Morgaon — tortoise-shaped fortified compound on the banks of the Karha River, four minarets at the corners, the original (and final) stop of Maharashtra's Astavinayak Yatra, devotees in white dhoti queueing at the eastern gate, soft Pune-district village morning light, 8 seconds

name: Siddhatek
prompt: Cinematic aerial over the Siddhivinayak temple on its Bhima River island at Siddhatek — the only east-facing Astavinayak, Bhima braided around the small island, the Daund road bridge connecting from the west, dry Ahmednagar plain stretching to the horizon, golden afternoon light, 8 seconds

name: Pali (Raigad)
prompt: Cinematic slow tilt up the Ballaleshwar temple at Pali in Raigad district — east-facing 1760 stone reconstruction of the original wooden shrine, named for the child devotee Ballal whose bhakti is said to have caused Ganesha to manifest, surrounding Sahyadri-edge village, soft Konkan-foothill morning, 8 seconds

name: Mahad (Raigad — Ashtavinayak)
prompt: Cinematic slow push toward the Varadvinayak temple at Mahad village in Raigad — the Nandadeep oil lamp visible inside the sanctum, burning continuously since 1892, lake-discovered idol on the brass throne, Khopoli-area village hush at dawn, soft pre-monsoon light, 8 seconds

name: Theur
prompt: Cinematic aerial over the Chintamani temple at Theur, 25km east of Pune — at the confluence of the Bhima, Mula and Mutha rivers, Madhavrao Peshwa's expansion gates and his sati-spot tulsi vrindavan, peshwa-era stone water tank reflecting the morning sky, 8 seconds

name: Lenyadri
prompt: Cinematic aerial up the Lenyadri rock-cut Buddhist caves above Junnar — 30 chambers staircased into the basalt cliff, Cave 7 (Girijatmaj Ganesha shrine, the only Astavinayak inside a Buddhist cave) marked by saffron flags at the climb's top, the 283-step pilgrim trail snaking up the slope, golden afternoon Sahyadri light, 8 seconds

name: Ozar
prompt: Cinematic dawn aerial over the gold-plated Vighnahar temple shikhara at Ozar in Junnar taluka — the gilded dome catching first light from across the Kukadi River, Bajirao-Peshwa-era stone steps to the river ghat, the ruby-eyed diamond-foreheaded idol just visible through the eastern gate, 8 seconds

name: Ranjangaon
prompt: Cinematic shot of the Mahaganapati temple at Ranjangaon at Surya-Sankranti dawn — engineered alignment of the inner sanctum captures the rising sun's rays falling directly on the deity's face, devotees holding their breath at the moment of light, 50km from Pune on the Ahmednagar highway, 8 seconds
